Title: Azure Virtual Network NAT now generally available in Azure Government and Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure Virtual Network NAT (network address translation) is now generally available in the Azure Government and Azure China regions. NAT simplifies outbound-only internet connectivity for virtual networks and can be configured for one or more subnets of a virtual network. It also provides on-demand connectivity for virtual machines as well as these capabilities: 

  • On-demand outbound to internet connectivity without pre-allocation 

  • Fully managed and highly resilient 

  • One or more static public IP addresses for scale 

  • Configurable idle timeout 

  • TCP reset for unrecognized connections 

  • Multi-dimensional metrics and alerts in Azure Monitor 

  • Optional zone isolation for availability zones 

Virtual Network NAT is now available in all Azure public clouds, Azure Government, and Azure China regions.

Learn more about Azure Virtual Network NAT.
